attempts.summary: On node1, blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false override), rebuilt the initramfs so the block is enforced at boot, verified modprobe cannot load the module, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until exec was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and re-verified post-reboot that usb-storage is still absent and modprobe still fails to load it.
